$schema_note: festivalId -> { name, start, end (UTC), evidence (the Lodestone announcement or special-site page), note }. Seeded from docs/data/festival-end-dates.json (Tsukimichi.Verify, game 2026.09.15) after checking each id's quests against the catalog. A past end turns that festival's undone quests Locked out while it is not running; the plugin shows 'ends <date> (Lodestone)' only for an end still ahead with an https evidence URL. Collaboration events rerun under the same Festival id, so their entries carry a name without an edition year, evidence and no dates; such an entry never locks its quests out. A collaboration may list its dated runs under runs: [{ start, end (UTC), evidence (the official page dating that run) }], oldest first; the run under way gives the running event its end date and ending-soon warning, and a run never locks anything out. An edition without a Lodestone window in docs/data/festival-end-dates.json may still carry its name with the year ("The Rising (2024)") and evidence (the Lodestone page, or the wiki's event page for one not yet announced) but no dates, so the plugin reads its real name and leaves it to the completed-quest rule. Festival ids with no Lodestone link (the 2023-2026 editions without one, Heavensturn and Hatching-tide 2014 whose wiki dates did not validate) are left out; the plugin then shows 'running now' only.
